facts.es: Consulta directa a la P-Chain el 15 de noviembre de 2026 (API pública api.metalblockchain.org, método platform.getCurrentValidators): 192 validadores activos, 184 de ellos conectados; ninguno con menos de 2.000 METAL de stake propio.
facts.en: Direct P-Chain query on 15 November 2026 (public API api.metalblockchain.org, method platform.getCurrentValidators): 192 active validators, 184 of them connected; none with less than 2,000 METAL of own stake.

facts.en: In the same query (15 Nov 2026), total primary-network stake was about 126.2 million METAL (platform.getTotalStake): about 54.95 million put up by the validators themselves and about 71.25 million delegated across 2,288 delegations.

facts.en: According to the chain itself (eosio.token contract, queried 15 Nov 2026), XPR supply was 32,739,941,120 XPR, with no maximum supply set.

sources.title: XPR Network – Explorador, contrato eosio.token (consultado el 15-nov-2026)

facts.es: En la red principal de XPR, el registro de tokens token.proton (2.787 entradas legibles el 15-nov-2026) no incluye ninguna stablecoin con marca de una cooperativa de crédito: las stablecoins que figuran son versiones envueltas (XUSDC, XUSDT, XPYUSD…), XMD y tokens de la comunidad. Encaja con que Metallicus sitúa las stablecoins del piloto en su entorno de pruebas; la red de pruebas no se pudo consultar.
facts.en: On XPR mainnet, the token.proton token registry (2,787 readable entries on 15 Nov 2026) contains no credit-union-branded stablecoin: the stablecoins listed are wrapped versions (XUSDC, XUSDT, XPYUSD…), XMD and community tokens. This is consistent with Metallicus placing the pilot stablecoins in its test environment; the testnet could not be queried.
